dedupe_keys.name: amis agricultural market information system data and outlook

description: The Agricultural Market Information System is an inter-agency platform that improves food market transparency and policy response for food security. It brings together the principal trading countries of agricultural commodities, assesses global food supplies and provides a forum to coordinate policy in times of market uncertainty. Its website shows current world production forecasts and changes from the previous season for wheat, maize, rice and soybeans (for 2026/27, updated 4 September 2026, wheat is forecast at 810.7 million tonnes, 3.8 per cent below the previous estimate), news analyses such as on palm oil and biodiesel policy, and events such as a webinar on Black Sea grain trade disruptions. Access is free. The licence is not stated on the home page read. Coverage is global for the four crops. Caveats: figures are forecasts that change between updates. For simulation it gives supply, demand and trade outlooks of staple crops for food-system shock and trade disruption scenarios. Related catalogue records include FAOSTAT and the GEOGLAM Crop Monitor.
